text:
olivia_sales: Quick heads up — Prospect ClearWave wants BYO-KMS (HSM) for their POC. Theyplan to host an HSM gateway behind a corporate outbound proxy. Asks: exact egress rules, pen-test slot, and a short POC price for BYO-KMS.

ben_eng: Connector can run as sidecar or managed connector in their VPC. Must allow outbound 443 to their HSM FQDN/IPs and support mTLS. If proxy terminates TLS we need TCP passthrough or mutual auth won't work.

zara_ops: Network note: allow outbound to their CIDR and ensure DNS resolution of their FQDN. Intercepting proxies add latency; measured +30-80ms median depending on HSM RTT. For stable p95 latency recommend dedicated routing.

mike_security: For the questionnaire request HSM vendor & model, FIPS attestation, whether keys are exportable, rotation process/cadence, and SOC2. Also ask whether key material ever leaves the HSM in plaintext.

kevin_se: Pricing: BYO-KMS = integration fee + per-unwrap routing fee + optional reserved capacity. For POC we often waive integration fee with pilot commitment. Need expected unwraps/sec and log retention (90/180/365d) to finalize.

olivia_sales: Customer says peak 150 unwraps/sec, avg ~13k/day, wants 180d logs, pen-test week of 2026-06-15.

kevin_se: Ballpark POC: waive integration fee for conversion-eligible pilot; ops add-on ~$2.5k/mo + $0.002/unwrap; reserved capacity add if SLOs required. I'll draft formal numbers.

ben_eng: POC plan: run connector in their VPC via private link; we'll supply a small harness to emulate unwraps. Example: "wrk -t8 -c150 -d45s https://staging-hsm.clearwave.local/unwrap". Capture TLS handshakes to validate client cert passthrough.

zara_ops: Pen-test note: infra can support week of 2026-06-15 with 72h scope notice and authorized IPs. Preflight checklist: non-destructive tests only, contact on-call. infra-bot: preflight link https://redwood.internal/pen-test-preflight

olivia_sales: Action list: 1) @mike_security craft short Q list and send today, 2) @kevin_se prepare POC quote with dedicated routing option and storage delta for 180d, 3) @ben_eng prepare runbook + harness, 4) @zara_ops prepare pen-test preflight + IP list. I'll schedule a 30m sync with ClearWave tomorrow. :thumbsup:
